note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient dialogue) as the primary source.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Once received, I will produce a concise, professional SOAP note in the exact structure you requested, including:
- Subjective: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history.
- Objective: physical findings, relevant exam details, any investigations if mentioned.
- Assessment & Plan: will include up to multiple issues with:
  - Likely diagnosis
  - Consistent differential diagnoses from the DDx (marked as conflict if inconsistent with transcript)
  - Investigations, treatments, and referrals as applicable
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, conflicts between transcript and DDx (with “conflict noted”), and brief transcript quality remarks.

If you have any constraints (e.g., preferred number of issues to list, or specific formatting), please mention them along with the data.
